visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with white text centered on a black background. (2) A woman with vibrant green hair, wearing a white sleeveless turtleneck top, sits in a cozy indoor setting. She holds a glass filled with a dark liquid, smiling broadly and then touching her face. The background includes framed pictures and a decorative lamp. (3) The woman is in a bathroom with white tiles; she looks upwards with a grimace, holding her chest, with text and emoji overlays. (4) Back in the room, she looks nervously at the camera while holding her glass. (5) She is in the bathroom again, looking distressed and holding her stomach while moving rhythmically. (6) A close-up shows a hand pressing a toilet flush lever, followed by hands being washed under a running faucet. (7) The woman in the bathroom sprays a bottle of air freshener into the air, with blue water-drop icons appearing. (8) She is back in the living room, smiling cheerfully and clapping her hands together. (9) She appears agitated, scratching her back and legs while making frustrated facial expressions. (10) The woman holds up two CeraVe products (a tub and a bottle) towards the camera in a brightly lit indoor space. (11) A montage shows her applying the lotion to her legs and arms. Close-ups of dry, cracked heels transition to smooth, moisturized skin. (12) She demonstrates applying cream to her face and hands. Split-screen shots show the different textures of the lotion and cream. (13) She stands in a room, spraying perfume onto her arms while holding a CeraVe product. (14) The video concludes with her presenting a promotional set including CeraVe products and a black '馬來貘' (LAIMO) branded mesh tote bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop music begins instantly with a strong rhythmic beat. A female voice speaks with high energy and an excited tone. (2) A comedic 'whoosh' sound effect plays as the speaker's tone shifts to mock distress. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (3) The female voice creates a laughing sound, followed by the sound of a toilet flushing and water running. The music continues at a steady 128 BPM. (4) A short, bright 'pop' sound effect marks a transition. The vocal delivery becomes more descriptive and narrative, maintaining high arousal. (5) SFX of a spray bottle being used. The speaker's tone is now cheerful and relieved. (6) A distinct 'ding' sound effect introduces a technical explanation section. The speaker's voice becomes more professional yet still friendly, enunciating clearly. (7) Sounds of cream being squeezed or applied are audible through a slight spectral shift. The music volume swells slightly during transitions. (8) The video concludes with a final energetic call-to-action by the female speaker, ending with a crisp hard cut in the audio.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Scenarios -> Solution Introduction -> Product Demonstration -> Promotional Offer
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote CeraVe moisturizing products by using relatable and humorous social scenarios (awkward dates) to highlight skin issues like itching and dryness, followed by a detailed demonstration of the product's benefits and an exclusive MOMO shopping offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly holds the products, explains their ingredients and benefits, and provides a clear call-to-action for a specific retailer (MOMO) and a limited-time collaboration.
